what: Iron Valley audit — one sealed open shed, one collider floating off its visual, one walk-through pile, one oversized collider, one misplaced ruin
cause: The stamp mill shed is open-sided on all four faces (a centre row of posts and a camshaft are the only visual obstructions) but collide() laid four full perimeter wall colliders over the footprint, so the player stopped dead on four invisible walls at a shed that reads as walk-in — the same visual/physics mismatch class as the town lots. The camshaft collider was anchored to heightAt at the plan centre while the structure seats at its lowest footing corner on an eastward-rising slope, so the collider guarded a band 1.3 m above the visible shaft. The second tailings cone (10 m wide, 3.5 m tall) was placed with collide=false and read as solid while the player walked straight through it. The headframe base collider used 2x2 half-extents on a 3.5x3.5 visual block, drawing an invisible 0.25 m collar of solid air. One of the three generic dark ruin boxes sat at (+16,+8) — entirely inside the mill's 16x12 footprint.
fix: structure() gained an openSided declaration and the stamp mill uses it: the four perimeter wall colliders are gone (the camshaft collider is the interior obstacle) and the collider-agreement check no longer demands wall colliders from a declared open-sided structure. The camshaft is raised to ride just clear of the highest terrain it crosses (real camshafts run high, driving the stamp heads from above — at floor+1.4 it dove underground at the shed's east end) and its collider now mirrors the visual cylinder exactly (centre camY, radius 0.4). Both tailings cones collide (second cone r=4 cylinder, same 0.8 collider-to-visual ratio as the first). Headframe base collider matches the visual at 1.75x1.75. The misplaced ruin moved west of the headframe to (-24,+2), clear of the mill, cones and the other ruins.

evidence.probes (before): movementBlocked into each mill wall line: south false / east true / north true / west true — but the three 'true' hits were the misplaced camshaft collider, not walls; cone2 resolvePosition displacement 0.000 (no collider); camshaft blocked at a y 1.3 m above its visual centre
evidence.probes (after): all four mill wall lines FREE; cone2 displacement 2.420; camshaft blocked exactly at its visual height, free above and below
evidence.sample-based invisible-wall sweep: before: mill south wall 0% covered, west wall 0% covered, headframe base 25% covered; after: only remaining flag is an ore cart at the mines POI 170 m away (out of scope)
